svg.text: Mass descriptors and calcifications at a glance · ACR BI-RADS Atlas, 5th edition
MASS · MARGIN (suspicion rises from left to right)
Density: high · equal · low · fat-containing (fat-containing masses are benign, e.g. lipoma, hamartoma, oil cyst)
CALCIFICATIONS · SUSPICIOUS MORPHOLOGY (fine linear or fine-linear branching carries the highest suspicion)
CALCIFICATION DISTRIBUTION (diffuse and regional are usually benign; linear and segmental suggest ductal disease)
